name: Clientjoy
description_en:
Clientjoy combines a sales CRM with the documents, customer portal and invoicing work used by a service business. Its intended journey runs from a lead through a proposal to an ongoing client and payment. A freelancer or small agency can use this model to keep commercial records and customer-facing administration connected rather than stopping at a won opportunity.

The current site still presents Clientjoy as the product; its terms name Synup Corporation and its help link points to Synup support. That relationship does not turn every Synup capability into a Clientjoy entitlement. This profile separates the documented CRM, portal, signature and payment functions and calls out inconsistent commercial and integration descriptions. It is public-document research, without a login, payment test or verified customer outcome.
description_zh:
Clientjoy 将销售 CRM 与服务型业务常用的文档、客户门户和开票工作结合起来，预期路径是从线索、提案到持续客户及付款。自由职业者或小型代理团队可以用这种模型连接商业记录和面向客户的行政工作，而非在机会成交后就结束跟踪。

当前网站仍把 Clientjoy 作为产品呈现；条款将公司写为 Synup Corporation，帮助链接指向 Synup 支持。这种关系不代表 Synup 的所有能力都包含在 Clientjoy 权益中。本文区分文档描述的 CRM、门户、签署与付款功能，并指出商业及集成说明中的不一致；没有登录、支付测试或已验证客户成效。

core_features.explanation_en: Use stages, deal amounts, custom fields and owner/tag filters to organize prospective work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用阶段、交易金额、自定义字段及负责人／标签筛选组织潜在工作。

core_features.explanation_en: Share documents, files, invoice information and embedded resources through a customer access area.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过客户访问区域共享文档、文件、发票信息和嵌入资源。

core_features.explanation_en: Personalize documents with merge fields, add a signature module and inspect document event logs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用合并字段个性化文档、加入签名模块并查看文档事件日志。

core_features.explanation_en: Create one-time, split or recurring invoices and configure a supported gateway.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建立一次性、分期或周期发票，并配置支持的支付网关。

en: Take a consulting lead through a proposal and an initial invoice.
Share ongoing work reports and documents in a client-facing portal.
zh: 把咨询线索推进到提案及首张发票。
在客户门户共享持续工作报告和文档。
use_cases.basis: Hypothetical workflows, not tested customer deployments.

Service model.en: Hosted subscription service with an app login and optional customer-facing domain branding; custom-domain use is not self-hosting.
Service model.zh: 托管订阅服务，提供应用登录及可选客户域名品牌化；自定义域名不等于自行托管。

steps.en: Define one service, lead stages and required proposal fields before bringing over customer data.
steps.zh: 导入客户数据前先定义一项服务、线索阶段及提案必需字段。

steps.en: Connect the intended mailbox/calendar and payment account with appropriate permissions and confirm package access.
steps.zh: 按适当权限连接目标邮箱／日历及支付账户，并确认套餐权限。

steps.en: For a purchase evaluation, verify one lead, personalized document, portal recipient and invoice state using test data. No such trial was performed for this catalog.
steps.zh: 购买评估时可用测试数据核对一条线索、个性化文档、门户接收人及发票状态。本目录没有进行这种试用。

items.name: Stripe recurring autopay
items.scope: Requires connected account and customer selecting auto debit; no live collection test.

items.name: Calendar and meeting location links
items.scope: Check calendar permissions; placing a meeting URL in Location does not demonstrate automatic meeting creation.

items.en: Email sequence sending capacity depends on the connected provider; the product page is not a universal deliverability guarantee.
items.zh: 邮件序列发送容量取决于连接的服务商；产品页不是普遍送达保证。

items.en: Payment page and pricing list disagree about GoCardless availability. That gateway is left unverified.
items.zh: 支付页和定价列表对 GoCardless 可用性描述不一致，因此保留未核实。

pricing.billing_basis: Top cards bundle members/client capacity; Enterprise card and older calculator language differ. Order form governs selected metrics.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Top cards: Starter $44/month billed annually or $49 monthly; Premium $89/month billed annually or $99 monthly. Mixed older text prevents a universal quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 顶部卡片：Starter 按年付款折算每月44美元或按月49美元；Premium 按年付款折算每月89美元或按月99美元。混杂旧说明，无法作为通用报价。

faq.question_en: Does a recurring invoice guarantee automatic collection?
faq.question_zh: 周期发票是否保证自动收款？
faq.answer_en: No. The payment page describes Stripe auto-pay and requires the client to enable auto debit. Issuing an invoice and settling it are different events.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。支付页说明 Stripe 自动付款，并要求客户启用自动扣款。开出发票和实际结算是不同事件。

faq.question_en: Does a branded portal mean I host the application?
faq.question_zh: 品牌门户是否代表自行托管应用？
faq.answer_en: No. The documented custom-domain/white-label option changes the customer-facing address and presentation of the hosted service.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。文档描述的自定义域名／白标选项改变托管服务面向客户的地址和外观。

sections.title_en: A consulting engagement from lead to proposal
sections.title_zh: 咨询业务从线索到提案
sections.en:
Imagine a consultant qualifying a request for a website audit. In an illustrative pipeline, record the lead owner, expected engagement value and the next follow-up, then move the lead through stages that reflect actual decisions. Clientjoy documents custom stages, custom fields, owner/tag filters and stage-value reporting.

Use a proposal template only after its merge fields resolve to the correct person, company and service. The document page describes a signature module and logs for document events. Review the rendered terms and recipient before sending. This hypothetical path was not executed, and event logs do not establish legal enforceability in a particular jurisdiction.
sections.zh:
假设咨询顾问正在判断一项网站审查需求。可在示例管线中记录线索负责人、预计项目金额及下一次跟进，再按真实决策推进阶段。Clientjoy 文档说明自定义阶段、字段、负责人／标签筛选及阶段金额报表。

提案模板使用前，应确认合并字段对应正确个人、公司和服务。文档页说明签名模块和文档事件日志；发送前仍需核对生成条款和接收人。本文未执行该假设流程，事件日志也不等于特定司法辖区中的法律效力结论。

sections.title_en: A portal organizes access; an embed keeps its own permissions
sections.title_zh: 门户组织入口，嵌入资源仍有自身权限
sections.en:
The portal page describes a password-protected client area for files, documents and invoices, with widgets for reports, links or a scheduler. Multiple contacts can be associated with the same customer. White labeling is described as an add-on for the customer-facing domain and logo; CSS/scripts customize presentation.

For evaluation, log in as two different example clients and check that each sees only the intended material. Also check the permissions of an embedded external report or file: displaying a link does not itself grant or constrain access at the external service. This is a test recommendation, not evidence of an observed exposure or validated isolation.
sections.zh:
门户页描述可访问文件、文档和发票的密码保护客户区域，也可用组件放入报告、链接或预约工具。同一客户可关联多个联系人；面向客户的域名和 Logo 白标被描述为附加项，CSS／脚本用于调整表现。

评估时建议分别用两个示例客户登录，检查各自仅见预期材料。同时核对嵌入的外部报告或文件权限：显示链接本身不会授予或约束外部服务中的访问权。这是测试建议，不表示已发现泄露或已验证隔离。

sections.title_en: Invoice schedules and payment state are separate
sections.title_zh: 发票计划与付款状态分开核对
sections.en:
Clientjoy describes one-time, split and recurring invoices, reminders, currencies and tax fields. For a hypothetical $1,200 engagement split into two equal invoices, each would represent $600 before any configured tax or fees. The split expresses a billing schedule, not a confirmed receipt of money. A bank transfer may need manual recording.

For automatic recurring collection, the payment page specifically describes a Stripe connection and the customer's auto-debit selection. Check a successful payment, a declined payment and a manual bank receipt as separate cases. Configuring a tax field is not evidence that the invoice satisfies every local tax requirement, and no payment, refund or accounting reconciliation was tested.
sections.zh:
Clientjoy 描述一次性、分期及周期发票、提醒、币种和税费字段。假设1,200美元项目分成两张等额发票，每张为600美元，未计配置的税费或手续费。分期表示开票安排，不代表已收到款项；银行转账可能需要手动记录。

自动周期收款方面，支付页明确说明 Stripe 连接及客户选择自动扣款。应分别检查付款成功、扣款被拒和手工银行收款。配置税费字段不能证明发票符合所有当地税务要求；本文未测试付款、退款或财务对账。

sections.title_en: Sequences and scheduling have external dependencies
sections.title_zh: 邮件序列与预约依赖外部服务
sections.en:
The sequence page describes spaced emails, merge fields and open/reply/no-response reporting. It also says daily capacity depends on the email service provider. Treat an open or click as a signal rather than a verified interested buyer; determine how opt-outs, replies and sending limits should stop or change the sequence. Those exact stopping and retry behaviors remain unverified.

The scheduler page describes availability, separate meeting links, calendar synchronization, questions and reminders. It says a Zoom, Meet or Teams address can be placed in the meeting location. That is not evidence that Clientjoy provisions a new conference automatically. Test time zones, a conflicting calendar event and rescheduling on the actual connected calendar.
sections.zh:
序列页说明分时邮件、合并字段以及打开／回复／未回复报表，也指出每日容量依赖邮件服务商。打开或点击只是信号，不等于已确认有兴趣的买家。应定义退订、回复及发送额度如何停止或改变序列；具体停止与重试行为仍未核实。

预约页说明可设置可用时间、不同预约链接、日历同步、问题和提醒，并表示可把 Zoom、Meet 或 Teams 地址填入会议地点。这不能证明 Clientjoy 自动创建新的会议室。应在实际连接日历上检查时区、冲突事件及改期。

sections.title_en: Use the current cards as a dated observation
sections.title_zh: 把当前卡片作为带日期的观察
sections.en:
The pricing page's top cards list Starter at $44/month billed annually or $49 paid monthly, including up to five team members and 25 client accounts. Premium is $89 or $99 respectively, with up to ten team members and 100 client accounts. These cards also include listing/review-management capacity. They are not the same model as multiplying every user by an old per-seat quote.

The same page contains an Enterprise per-member card and older calculator/table wording, including broader unlimited claims. The payment page calls GoCardless a roadmap item while the price table lists it. Do not combine these statements into an imaginary all-inclusive package. Confirm the order form, feature access, white-label scope, renewal term and gateway charges before purchase; no normalized total is recorded.
sections.zh:
定价页顶部卡片列出 Starter 按年付款折算每月44美元，按月付款49美元，最多5名团队成员和25个客户账户。Premium 对应为89或99美元，最多10名团队成员及100个客户账户。卡片还包括商家信息／评价管理容量；这不是把旧的每席位报价乘以全部用户的同一种模型。

同一页面还保留 Enterprise 按成员计价卡片，以及含更宽泛不限量说法的旧计算器／表格文字。支付页称 GoCardless 属于路线图，而价格表已列出它。不能把这些声明组合成虚构的全包套餐。购买前应确认订单、功能权限、白标范围、续订期限及网关费用；本文不填写统一总价。

sections.en:
The public terms identify Clientjoy as Synup Corporation and grant limited use of a proprietary subscription service. They tie purchased functionality and user/usage metrics to the order form. This does not establish that every Synup product is enabled in a Clientjoy account, or that a custom domain provides application source code.

The trial is limited to evaluating a subscription purchase and ends without continued access unless a subscription is purchased. This catalog used public pages only and did not enter a trial. The terms also describe automatic renewal and fees; reconcile the selected agreement with the pricing page's broad cancel-anytime language rather than assuming a refund entitlement.
sections.zh:
公开条款将 Clientjoy 定义为 Synup Corporation，并授予专有订阅服务的有限使用权。已购买功能及用户／用量指标与订单关联。这不能证明所有 Synup 产品都已在 Clientjoy 账户启用，也不代表自定义域名提供应用源代码。

试用仅用于评估是否购买订阅；若未购买，试用结束后不再继续访问。本目录只读取公开网页，没有进入试用。条款还说明自动续订和费用，应将所选协议与定价页笼统的随时取消文字对照，不能据此假定可退款。

sections.title_en: Fit a service-business workflow, then verify the exceptions
sections.title_zh: 先匹配服务业务流程，再核实异常
sections.en:
Clientjoy is a relevant candidate when proposals, ongoing client communication and invoices are part of the same small-team workflow. Evaluate one complete path rather than treating the number of features as proof of fit. A business needing detailed delivery scheduling, full accounting or transaction guarantees must verify those requirements independently.

The official help link points to Synup support but could not be read by the public reader in this session. Detailed permission matrices, API quotas, export/migration mechanics, gateway-specific recovery and exact plan exclusions therefore remain gaps. UI languages, data residency and regional payment eligibility were not established. No customer claims, quality ranking or operational reliability test is implied by this draft.
sections.zh:
当提案、持续客户沟通和发票属于同一个小团队流程时，Clientjoy 可列入候选。应评估完整路径，不能把功能数量当作适配证明。若需要细致交付排期、完整会计或事务保证，必须另外验证相应需求。

官方帮助链接指向 Synup 支持，但本次公共阅读器无法读取，因此详细权限矩阵、API 额度、导出／迁移机制、各网关恢复方式及准确套餐排除项仍有缺口。界面语言、数据驻留和地区支付资格也未确认。草稿不表示客户成效、质量排名或运行可靠性测试。

seo.title_en: Clientjoy: Prospect-to-Payment CRM, Portal and Pricing Caveats
seo.title_zh: Clientjoy：线索到收款 CRM、客户门户与定价注意项
seo.description_en: Explore Clientjoy sales stages, proposals, portals, invoices and payment dependencies, with official-source pricing inconsistencies and limits.
seo.description_zh: 了解 Clientjoy 销售阶段、提案、门户、发票和支付依赖，并查看官方来源中的定价不一致及限制。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Clientjoy for a service-business prospect-to-payment process.
secondary_questions: How do invoices and Stripe autopay differ?
Is the client portal white label?
Which pricing model is shown now?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent, no keyword or ranking measurements.

research_gaps.en: Official Synup help target was inaccessible. Exact role permissions, APIs, exports, migration and payment-failure recovery require further documentation or purchase evaluation.
research_gaps.zh: 官方 Synup 帮助目标无法读取；准确角色权限、API、导出、迁移和支付失败恢复需进一步查文档或在购买评估中核实。

research_gaps.en: Pricing and gateway descriptions conflict across official sections. No checkout, trial, payment, signature or portal isolation test was performed; regional availability, data residency and UI languages remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 官方不同章节的价格及网关描述冲突。未进行结账、试用、支付、签署或门户隔离测试；地区可用性、数据驻留和界面语言仍未知。
